name: Check the unpack folder by descriptor, not by path
body: D-224 leaves two limits: (1) the administrator can change any folder's mode, so `chmod` doesn't prove ownership, and root naming a shared folder in `LANTERN_CACHE_DIRECTORY` could reuse one another user pre-created; (2) in a parent other users can write to without the sticky bit, a checked folder could be replaced after the check. Close both by opening the folder with `O_NOFOLLOW | O_DIRECTORY`, then `fstat` its owner against the effective user id and keep the descriptor (or use `openat` from it) through marker reads, extraction and loading. Needs per-platform `struct stat` and open-flag bindings, or a small native helper in lantern-native. Left open for the prototype (Dean, via the coordinator, 2026-11-20).
acceptance_criteria: Root refuses a folder owned by another user
A folder replaced between check and use is not read
Works on macOS and Linux; Windows unchanged
